release_notes: Release v1.0.4 adds MEA task runs, optional LLM fallback, a tool-call journal, opt-in self-evolution and a responsive chat-first workspace. It fixes private task persistence, coordinated stop and reset, outage caching, concurrent automation updates and sidebar resize accessibility.
